Name: Bog Style Medieval Tiny Sheds for Alternative Textures
Author: glitchcrow
Description:
I really love the Tiny Shed mod and also all of Bogwyytch's mods so this is my attempt at combining the two

The mod covers all upgrades and is seasonal. Currently there are purple, green, red, and blue mushroom stye sheds based on Bog's junimo huts and cabins.

Credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch]Bogwyytch[/url] for the original assets used as the base and their mods overall for the inspiration
to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Shyziie]Shyziie[/url] for their awesome Tiny Sheds mod
